policy: Actual five singles and fifteen fixed mixed faces. Merge two physical singles at the common hand checkpoint in physical hand order; retain the oldest held instance modifications through the existing inherit policy. Full-hand admission precedes merging; exact material, opening and timing policies require CN calibration. Spell bodies retain their printed ordered steps; two random destruction targets share one captured group.
